title: Jesus... I Keep Waiting To Deserve The Light. 🌅
topic: she waits in her dark season to deserve the morning, sure light only visits people who already have their lives together

bible.text: Through the tender mercy of our God; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us,

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I keep waiting to deserve the light. 🌅

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Dawn looks like something you climb to, not something sent.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: The dayspring visits from on high. Dawn comes down; it doesn't check merit.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Even sitting here in the middle of the dark?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Especially there. Light is given to them that sit in darkness.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You don't earn mornings. You wake up inside one.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to someone sitting in the dark tonight. 🌅
